requirements.heading: Author Header Field
requirements.text: * If an Author: field already exists, a new one MUST NOT be created, and the existing one MUST NOT be modified.

requirements.heading: Author Header Field
requirements.text: * An author's MUA or MSA MAY create an Author: field, and its value MUST be identical to the value in the From: field.

requirements.heading: Author Header Field
requirements.text: * A Mediator MAY create an Author: field if one does not already exist, and this new field's value MUST be identical to the value of the From: field at the time the Mediator received the message (and before the Mediator causes any changes to the From: field).
